title: Launcher
responsibility: Install and run the shell from one documented command: build the application, start it, own both the application process and the file watcher, and terminate the watcher with the application.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ PRODUCTION MODE ONLY (DEC-0018): `next build` then `next start`. `next dev` is a contributor workflow and is not a shipped configuration — AST-0015 showed the two produce different artifacts, so shipping the development server would mean shipping something this project can never validate. ⚠️ THE PROCESS OWNERSHIP IS AN OBLIGATION WITH NO MECHANISM YET, deliberately. The skeleton creates its watcher on `listen` and closes it in its own `close()`, but that belongs to a process owning its own HTTP server; under `next start` there is no such object and nothing has been run. Choosing and validating the binding is this component's design work.
